properties.name: Oversight Agency

properties.name: Oversight Committees

properties.name: Parliamentary Majority

properties.name: Parliamentary Oversight

properties.name: Parliamentary Sessions

properties.name: Party Discipline

properties.name: Party System

properties.name: Party Unity

properties.name: Personal Politics

properties.name: Petition or Legislation

properties.name: Pluralist Democracy

properties.name: Policy Agenda

properties.name: Policy Analysis

properties.name: Policy Deliberation

properties.name: Policy Disagreement

properties.name: Policy Discussion

properties.name: Policy Entrepreneurs

properties.name: Policy Formulation

properties.name: Policy Initiatives

properties.name: Policy Making

properties.name: Policy Passage

properties.name: Policy Recommendations

properties.name: Policy Viability

properties.name: Political Beliefs

properties.name: Political Campaign
properties.definition: An organized effort to influence voters and win elections.

properties.name: Political Campaigns

properties.name: Political Climate

properties.name: Political Conduct

properties.name: Meritocracy

properties.name: Military

properties.name: Minimum Participation
properties.definition: The least number of participants required for a decision-making process to be valid.

properties.name: Minority Exclusion

properties.name: Minority Representation

properties.name: Misconduct Allegations

properties.name: Moderation in Governance
properties.definition: A political approach that favors compromise, pragmatism, and avoidance of extremism.

properties.name: Modern Democracy

properties.name: Monetary Transactions

properties.name: Name Recognition

properties.name: National Courts

properties.name: National Development

properties.name: National Interest

properties.name: National Legislature

properties.name: National Security Agency

properties.name: National Unity and Local Control

properties.name: Nonpartisan Governance

properties.name: Nonpartisan Oversight

properties.name: Nonpartisan Views

properties.name: Nonviolent Movements

properties.name: Open Government

properties.name: Limited Mandate

properties.name: Fiscal Policy

properties.name: Death Penalty Ethics

properties.name: Juvenile Justice Ethics
properties.definition: Normative principles guiding responses to youth offending, balancing accountability with development and capacity.

properties.name: Disability Rights
properties.definition: The ethical demand for equal dignity, access, and non-discrimination of persons with disabilities across all aspects of life.

properties.name: Freedom of Religion (Normative)

properties.name: Freedom of Assembly (Normative)

properties.name: Digital Rights

properties.name: Data Privacy (Normative)
properties.definition: The ethical principle that individuals control personal data and are protected against unjustified collection and use.

properties.name: Algorithmic Fairness

properties.name: AI Ethics
properties.definition: Principles guiding the development and use of AI to ensure accountability, transparency, rights protection, and human welfare.

properties.name: Genetic Engineering Ethics

properties.name: Organ Donation Ethics

properties.name: Animal Rights
